entries.d9416f416b17f75a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,984,743 million, up 7.7% from ¥1,842,357 million in the previous fiscal year (the fiscal year ended March 2025). Revenue from external customers was ¥1,203,091 million for the Real Estate Leasing Business, ¥544,283 million for the Construction Business, ¥147,083 million for the Real Estate Development Business, ¥12,808 million for the Financial Business and ¥77,475 million for Other. The Real Estate Leasing Business rose 3.3% against a background of an increase in bulk-leased properties and high occupancy rates; bulk leasing accounted for ¥1,065,410 million (88.6%) of it.
